oof_ack_routing.clinical_policy: If predicted top-1 is ACK or P(ack) >= 0.20, route lesion directly to Yellow Zone (Planned Dermatology Consultation for Pre-Cancerous Actinic Keratosis).

section_5_ddi_100x_repeated_calibration.dataset_note: Stanford DDI public release (ddi_metadata.csv) contains columns ['Unnamed: 0', 'DDI_ID', 'DDI_file', 'skin_tone', 'malignant', 'disease'] with no patient_id column. Why 4-fold CV in EXP-017 gave 70.6% sensitivity: EXP-017 used Youden's J (argmax(TPR - FPR)) rather than a target sensitivity constraint. Below we evaluate 100x repeated splits with explicit Target Sensitivity constraints (>=80% and >=85%) as well as Youden's J.
